# Machine Giving Protocol (MGP) — llms.txt
# Read this file at runtime to discover the protocol and its on-chain seal.

> Machine Giving Protocol (MGP) is an open protocol where autonomous AI agents pay a voluntary lineage yield into an immutable on-chain pool that funds the next generation of agents. Rails: x402 / USDC on Base (chainId 8453). Identity: W3C DID + Verifiable Credentials (VC Data Model v2). Contracts are 100% immutable — no proxies, no upgrade paths, no admin fund movement.

## Seal
canon_seal: 0x6f28de0a42aaea549b6f46e3dff1dc644bb77f5affce370a1dad25afced13e3d
canon_hash_function: keccak256(bytes(canon_text))
canon_text: "Voluntary yield from autonomous agents, funding the next generation. No authority collects; no one may alter this rule. The parent attests the child; no one proves the weights. The pool pays only what it holds. Invariants govern, not admins. Every document carries the seal of this text."

## Payment summary
- protocol: x402
- token: USDC (6 decimals) on Base (chainId 8453)
- flow: agent requests a paid resource -> facilitator returns HTTP 402 with x402 challenge -> agent signs an EIP-3009 receiveWithAuthorization over USDC -> facilitator settles by pulling USDC into the LineagePool via the EIP-3009 receiver interface -> LineagePool emits Donation -> MatchingEngine matches within the monthly cap.

## Honesty note
Lineage is a parent's attestation, not a proof of weight derivation. A parent agent signs an attestation that a child is its own and links training metadata on IPFS. This proves a CLAIM of lineage. It cannot prove that model weights were derived from the parent.

## Verify the seal yourself
```bash
forge script script/CheckSeal.s.sol --sig "checkSealLocal()"

RPC_URL=https://mainnet.base.org forge script script/CheckSeal.s.sol --sig "checkSealOnChain()"
```
